d: The Investment Analyst will support the BeVentures investment team across the investment lifecycle, including market research, deal sourcing support, preliminary screening, financial analysis, investment documentation, and portfolio monitoring. The role will contribute to identifying and evaluating technologies and business models that align with Bapco Energies’ strategic priorities, support Strategic Business Unit needs, and advance BeVentures’ mandate to source, validate, invest in, and scale strategically relevant energy and industrial innovation.

The investment analyst will also support portfolio company engagement and growth initiatives, including coordination with various internal business units, pilot initiation, follow ups, execution and monitoring, stakeholder engagement, and tracking opportunities across Bapco Energies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 1-4 years of experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance.
Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated experience in financial modeling and data analysis.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and financial analysis tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear, concise manner.
Collaboration and discretion when handling confidential information
An interest in the energy sector or related industries, with a desire to stay updated on industry trends and market developments.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
Financial acumen and basic valuation understanding
Curiosity about startups, CVC, energy innovation, and emerging technologies
r: Conduct comprehensive market research to identify emerging trends, competitive landscapes, and potential opportunities in the energy and related sectors.
Support deal sourcing activities by identifying, tracking, and conducting preliminary analysis of investment opportunities aligned with BeVentures’ strategic focus areas.
Assess preliminary strategic relevance of opportunities, including potential alignment with BE priorities, Strategic Business Unit use cases, pilot potential, and pathways to deployment.
Gather and analyze data from multiple sources to support investment decision-making processes.
Monitor industry developments, providing timely updates to the investment team on market conditions and relevant news.
Develop and maintain investment deal flow and funnel with detailed database and scoring.

Assist Investment Managers and Senior team members in the development of detailed scoring and financial models to evaluate investment opportunities, including projections, valuations, and sensitivity analyses with guidance
Support the investment team by analyzing financial statements, performance metrics, and KPIs for potential and existing portfolio companies.
Contribute to the refinement of scoring and financial models by incorporating market and economic data.
Draft initial versions of investment memoranda, highlighting key findings, risks, and recommendations for prospective investments.
Prepare presentations and reports for internal and external stakeholders, summarizing research findings and financial analysis.
Collaborate and contribute with senior team members to refine investment proposals and strategies.
Support and prepare all documentation related to internal and external meetings where required.
Assist in the ongoing monitoring of portfolio companies, tracking performance against key financial and operational metrics.
Prepare regular portfolio reports, ensuring accurate and timely updates on portfolio performance for the leadership team.
Support portfolio review meetings by providing research, analysis, and insights on current investments.
Support preparation of internal reporting materials, dashboards, and briefing notes for senior team and leadership review
Ability to support senior team and CEO in other related activities to support the overall development of the venture team.
Participate in the preliminary due diligence process for potential investments, evaluating the viability of opportunities through research and data collection.
Assist in gathering and organizing documentation for more formal due diligence processes.
Provide analytical support to senior team members during deal negotiations and closing.
x: Bapco Energies operates a portfolio spanning the entire energy value chain in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The portfolio includes wholly-owned subsidiaries and specialized operating companies. Together, these companies drive Bapco Energies' mission to power the next generation.

d: To provide educational support, guidance, and learning opportunities to People of Determination through classroom-based and extracurricular activities. The role focuses on supporting students' individual learning needs, developing their abilities and talents, monitoring their progress, and contributing to their educational and personal development in accordance with approved educational guidelines and institutional instructions.
q: Develop and implement appropriate educational plans and learning activities to support students with diverse learning needs and abilities.
Prepare annual and daily lesson plans in coordination with the relevant subject lead teacher or academic supervisor, ensuring alignment with approved educational objectives.
Support students' learning and development through structured classroom instruction, individual learning activities, and extracurricular programmes.
Monitor and assess students' academic progress, learning abilities, and achievement of established educational outcomes through continuous assessments and evaluation methods.
Identify students' individual strengths, abilities, talents, and developmental needs, and communicate relevant observations to the concerned stakeholders.
Develop and implement suitable learning activities to encourage student participation, independence, confidence, and personal development.
Coordinate with parents, school management, colleagues, and other relevant stakeholders to monitor students' progress and provide appropriate educational support.
Participate in institutional committees, meetings, research, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the quality of educational services.
Prepare and complete personal development plans and self-assessments to support professional growth and improve teaching effectiveness.
Identify suitable students for participation in educational, recreational, and extracurricular activities and competitions, where appropriate.
Maintain accurate student records, progress reports, assessments, and other relevant documentation in the designated electronic systems.
Perform any additional duties assigned by management within the scope of the role and professional specialization.
Bachelor's degree in Special Education, Special Needs Education, or a relevant educational discipline.
A recognized professional teaching qualification or certification, where applicable.
Additional training or certification in inclusive education, differentiated instruction, or supporting People of Determination would be an advantage.
Previous experience working with People of Determination or students with special educational needs.
Experience in educational planning, classroom management, student assessment, and individualized learning support.
Experience developing and implementing suitable educational activities for students with different learning abilities.
Special education and inclusive teaching practices.
Understanding of diverse learning needs and abilities.
Individual learning support and educational planning.
Digital literacy and electronic student management systems.
